description: Ministry of National Policies & Economic Affairs - Order under Securities & Exchange Commission  Act, that the rate of Cess to be Charged and Levied
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 36 of 1987. It specifies and amends rates of cess (a type of tax) on various securities transactions. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to issue regulatory orders, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The content primarily deals with financial regulations and compliance requirements, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
